items.title: FORGIVENESS
items.quote: O G-d, grant me favor [and forgive my sins] as befitting Your kindness. And as befits the abundance of Your compassion, erase my transgressions.
items.text: Ask Hashem to forgive your sins out of compassion, even though you feel that you don’t deserve it.

items.title: PURIFICATION
items.quote: Cleanse me thoroughly from my iniquity and purify me from my sin.
items.text: Ask Hashem to restore your sensitivity to sin so that you will more readily recognize sinful temptations in the future. Let your cleansing be like soap that washes away a stain.

items.title: CONFESSION
items.quote: For I have come to recognize my transgressions. And my sin is always before me.
items.text: Humbly admit that you have sinned and express your deep regret.

items.title: ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
items.quote: I have sinned against You alone. I did what was evil in Your eyes.
items.text: Examine yourself to acknowledge a hidden sin. Even if the world is not aware of it, you have sinned against Hashem and have undermined your relationship with Him.

items.title: ACCEPTANCE
items.quote: Therefore, You are just in holding me guilty. You are right in Your judgment.
items.text: If you are experiencing physical distress or danger, accept the justice of your punishment. If the purpose of your suffering has been served, Hashem will give you relief.

items.quote: Indeed, I was fashioned in iniquity.
items.text: Ask for compassion because the tendency to sin is inherent in the human condition.

items.title: RESOLVE
items.quote: Nevertheless, You have wanted truth in my covered parts and in my concealed heart You teach me wisdom.
items.text: Ask Hashem for help in arousing your conscience and your will to enable you to overcome your human weaknesses in the future.

items.title: HUMILITY
items.quote: Purge me of sin with hyssop. Then I shall be pure. Wash me and I shall be whiter than snow.
items.text: On asking to be purified of sin, express deep humility (symbolized by the hyssop), with a broken heart as your offering to Hashem.

items.title: JOY
items.quote: Make me hear joy and happiness.
items.text: Ask Hashem to grant you the joy of being free of sin once more.

items.title: RESOLVE
items.quote: Create a pure heart for me, O G-d, and renew a firm spirit within me.

items.title: RESTORATION
items.quote: Don’t discard me from Your presence.
items.text: Ask Hashem to restore His relationship with you and not to treat you as repugnant to Him.

items.quote: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation.

items.title: GUIDANCE
items.quote: I will teach Your ways to transgressors and sinners will return to You.
items.text: If you have the opportunity, use the insight you have gained to give guidance to others.

items.title: RESCUE AND PRAISE
items.quote: Rescue me from blood-guilt, O G-d. O G-d of my slavation, my tongue will sing joyously of Your kind justice.
items.text: Ask Hashem in His kindness to accept your teshuvah and thereby rescue you from a harsh penalty, for which you might be marked because of your sins.

items.quote: O my L-rd, open my lips so that my mouth may declare Your praise.
items.text: Offer Hashem your promise of sincere gratitude and praise which His forgiveness will enable.

items.quote: The sacrifices for G-d are a broken spirit. O G-d, You don’t spurn a heart that is broken and contrite.

items.title: YERUSHALAYIM
items.quote: Establish Tzion at the right time when it pleases You. Build the walls of Yerushalayim.
items.text: Ask Hashem to bring the Geulah and restore Yerushalayim so that sacrificial offerings may once more be brought with the proper devotion and sincerity.

items.quote: Then You will want the offerings of righteousness, burnt-offering and whole-offering.
